en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Al Halby, raising it,
‘Heasws said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The salvation of a ‘Momin’ (the Believer) lies in preservation of his tongue’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from al- Halabi in a marfu’ manner from the Messenger of Allah who has said the following:
“The salvation of a believer is in his controlling his tongue.”
